name: DMS Last.fm & ListenBrainz Scrobbler
author: arqueon
description: Last.fm and ListenBrainz companion for DMS: scrobbling, love/unlove feedback sync, Control Center tile, profile links, and a per-service offline retry queue. Optional remote Now Playing polls Last.fm or ListenBrainz; optional artwork search sends track metadata to YouTube Music. An optional MPRIS bridge needs a C compiler, libsystemd and json-c headers.
